calendarFaqs.q: When does Jefferson County Schools start in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The first student day is Wednesday, August 12, 2026. JEFCOED schedules staff workdays and professional development on August 6, 7, 10, and 11 before students begin.

calendarFaqs.q: Are JEFCOED E-Learning days student holidays?
calendarFaqs.a: No. September 8, October 9, February 12, and April 9 are E-Learning days for students. Staff have either professional development or a teacher workday on those dates.

calendarFaqs.q: When do students return after JEFCOED Holiday Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Holiday Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. January 4 is professional development and January 5 is a teacher workday, so students return Wednesday, January 6.

calendarFaqs.q: What is a JEFCOED Opportunity Day?
calendarFaqs.a: The district calendar marks October 15 and March 9 as Opportunity Days for high schools only. The calendar does not give one attendance rule for all high school students, so families should check with their school.

calendarFaqs.q: Are the JEFCOED weather days guaranteed days off?
calendarFaqs.a: No. February 15 and March 22–23 are identified as weather days if needed. Check JEFCOED announcements before treating those dates as confirmed days off.

calendarFaqs.q: Does JEFCOED publish a Spanish 2026–27 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. JEFCOED publishes an official Spanish version with the same school-year dates as the English calendar. Both PDFs are linked in Official Calendars and Downloads.

whatsNew.title: What Changed from the 2025–26 JEFCOED Calendar?
whatsNew.subtitle: Verified differences between the two official school-year calendars.
content: The first student day is August 12 in 2026–27, compared with August 7 in 2025–26.
The last student day is May 27 in 2026–27, compared with May 21 in 2025–26.
JEFCOED lists four E-Learning days in 2026–27, compared with five published E-Learning dates in 2025–26.
Spring Break begins March 22 in 2026–27, compared with March 23 in 2025–26.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 23, 2026, against JEFCOED’s official English and Spanish 2026–27 calendar PDFs.
sourceReviewDetailsTitle: How we reviewed the JEFCOED calendar
sourceReviewDetails: Checked every districtwide date on the one-page English calendar, including student attendance dates, E-Learning days, staff days, school closures, grading-period endings, Opportunity Days, and conditional weather dates.
Compared the Spanish edition with the English calendar. The school-year dates and schedule labels match.

The English file says Board Approved 1/22/26, while the Spanish file prints Board Approved 2/22/26. The Spanish PDF was created February 2, before its printed date, so this page treats that approval stamp as a source-file discrepancy rather than a separate calendar revision.
Kept Opportunity Days separate from districtwide no-school dates because the source limits them to high schools and does not publish one attendance rule for every high school student.
Marked February 15 and March 22–23 as conditional because the calendar says they are weather days only if needed.
sourceNextReviewText: We review this page again if JEFCOED replaces either calendar PDF, uses a designated weather make-up day, or announces a districtwide schedule change.
